input.summary: Add Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity and narrow Customer's indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 contains only a Customer indemnity for "every claim" relating to our use, with no Vendor indemnity at all. We have added the standard Vendor indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct/gross negligence, and narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our own breach of law.

ops.oldText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from third-party claims to the extent arising out of content Customer provides to the Services or Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: 20.2 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The indemnified Party shall give prompt notice, the indemnifying Party shall control the defence, and the indemnified Party shall reasonably cooperate at the indemnifying Party's expense.

input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot restrict the products or services we develop, buy or sell, so we have deleted Section 12.4; it also directly contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no non-compete commitment.
